Dharavi Redevelopment Project Construction Begins After Bhoomi Poojan

Construction has commenced on the Dharavi Redevelopment Project in Mumbai following a Bhoomi Poojan ceremony at a Matunga site. The project will build 10,432 rehabilitation homes for Dharavi residents. Adani is the developer undertaking this construction.
